notes: ACCESS: Chrome connector only, one dedicated tab, no block of any kind at any point (no 403 / DataDome / Akamai / CAPTCHA / rate limit). robots.txt names no Claude or Anthropic agent - only a generic 'User-agent: *' block on basket/checkout/search/facet URLs, which does not cover the category URLs used here. METHOD: castorama.fr is a React-Router SSR app. The whole mega-nav lives in window.__reactRouterDataRouter.state.loaderData.root.HEADER_DATA.meganav (2061 nodes: id/name/href/parent/children). Category pages come in two shapes - PLPs, which expose loaderData['routes/plp'].lister, and curated hub pages, which do not. COUNTS: taken from lister.meta.paging.totalResults. That is exactly the number the page renders in its own results header - verified on /table-basse/, where the rendered header read '9 289 produits' (U+202F thousands separator) and totalResults was 9289. Child categories and their exact counts come from lister.categories on the parent PLP (entries whose seoUrl matches /cat_id_N.cat; entries ending '-dyn.cat' are colour/material/shape FACET landing pages and were excluded). Those facet counts were cross-checked three ways: Table fixe 3459 / Table extensible 3236 / Table console 1373 each matched the child page's own header exactly, and children summed exactly to the parent on Bibliotheque (3109+2396+103=5608) and Fauteuil interieur (=3835). Pages were driven by client-side router navigation at roughly one request every 5 seconds. DISPLAY CAP: totalResults saturates at exactly 10200, at which point the rendered header switches to 'Plus de 10 000 produits' (confirmed by reading the DOM on the Sideboards page). Buffet, Canape, Armoire penderie, Chaise de salle a manger and Lit coffre all returned exactly 10200, and Armoire penderie's own child 'Armoire portes coulissantes' reads 13439 - proving 10200 is a cap, not a total. Capped LEAF nodes are emitted with qty null and a flag; capped PARENT nodes are grouping rows in any case. TREE SOURCES (all three walked, union taken): the meganav, the category sitemap https://www.castorama.fr/fstrz/sm/sitemap-cat.xml (4841 category URLs), and each category page's own sub-category tile strip / category facet. The nav under-reports badly: 'Table a manger' has three children (Table haute 392, Table pliante 74, Table relevable 5) absent from the mega-menu, and the ENTIRE BEDS branch (/lit/cat_id_0004641.cat, about twenty bed-type leaves plus the Lit enfant and Lit bebe sub-trees) appears under none of the five furniture-bearing departments in the mega-nav - it was found only through the sitemap. IN SCOPE / OUT OF SCOPE: Castorama is a DIY chain, so the great majority of its 4841 categories (building materials, tools, plumbing, electrical, paint, flooring, garden tools, appliances) is out of scope and was not touched. Excluded deliberately: the room cross-cut hubs 'Meuble d'entree', 'Meuble de salon', 'Meuble de chambre' and 'Meuble de salle a manger' (they re-list nodes already recorded); clothes rails and valet stands (Portant vetement branch); shoe racks (Range chaussures); wall shelves (Etagere murale) and bathroom shelves; storage boxes, baskets, bins and crates; the Atomia modular components (shelves, drawers, doors, fittings); wardrobe/closet doors and closet fittings; moving supplies; furniture parts and covers (Plateau de table, Pied de table, Plateau de bureau, Treteau, Housse de chaise, Assise de chaise, Housse de penderie, Housse de salon de jardin); the whole Literie branch - mattresses, bed bases and headboards, the last of which exist only as '-dyn.cat' facets and not as real categories; kitchen door fronts, drawers, handles, plinths and fixings; kitchen cupboard organisers; bathroom worktops; bed tents and slides; camping beds and inflatable mattresses; and the '-dyn.cat' style/collection landing pages (for example meuble-de-salle-de-bains-industriel, meuble-de-salle-de-bains-vintage, table-basse-bois, table-basse-ronde), which return the parent population under a filter. KNOWN GAP: 'Meuble four encastrable' (built-in-oven housing unit, /meuble-four-encastrable/cat_id_0005736.cat) was identified but not counted. COUNT DRIFT: this is a live marketplace and totals move slightly within a session (Console 810 then 812, Coiffeuse 1013 then 1018, Petit tabouret 563 then 562). The later read is recorded and the three affected rows are flagged.
